Researchers have assessed its condition and theorized its submersion history. This find not only contributes to Wisconsin's storied history of ancient canoes but also sheds light on Indigenous practices.

title: 50 cities, 70,000 protesters: Spain’s housing crisis fuels nationwide anger
description: Protests erupted in multiple Spanish cities, including Madrid, following the rejection of rental protection measures by parliament. Tens of thousands of demonstrators demanded action on the housing crisis affecting vulnerable renters. The anger was sparked by the eviction of an elderly woman, who became a symbol of the housing struggles. The rising rental costs have made affordable housing increasingly out of reach for many citizens.

title: 'Parents oppose marriage': Andhra man kills 19-year-old girlfriend, jumps to death
description: Mahalakshmi, a young woman of 19, lost her life after a brutal knife attack by her ex-boyfriend, Chinna Rao, aged 22. The assault occurred at her home, where Chinna's persistent harassment, stemming from family opposition, culminated in violence. Mahalakshmi suffered grave injuries and passed away after four hours in the hospital. In a heartbreaking conclusion, Chinna leaped from a building, ending his life shortly after the attack.

title: 'Attacked with hammer': RSS functionary Rameshwar Tiwari dies after assault in UP

His wife, Amrita Devi, filed an FIR against several named and unnamed individuals involved in the incident. Four police personnel have been suspended due to negligence in handling the situation prior to the attack. The conflict reportedly stemmed from an old land property issue between families in the area.

title: US released Asian lady beetles to fight pests; decades later, they became invasive
description: Originally imported to the United States for biological pest control, the multicoloured Asian lady beetle, or Harmonia axyridis, has turned invasive. Competing with native ladybugs, this species disrupts ecosystems. While it helps manage aphid populations, its autumn behavior drives adult beetles to invade homes, creating an unwanted nuisance. This case serves as a cautionary tale about the unintended effects of introducing nonnative species into local environments.

title: Ukraine confirms India playing big role in mediating energy truce in Black Sea

During recent communications, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha emphasized the importance of India's mediation role. India's external affairs minister S Jaishankar affirmed continuous engagement with both Kyiv and Moscow regarding potential solutions. Ukraine is open to discussing limited ceasefire arrangements around energy infrastructure and safe Black Sea shipping.

title: Delhi-NCR housing prices rise 12% in Q3, highest among top seven cities: Report
description: Housing prices in the Delhi-NCR region increased by 12 percent annually during the July-September quarter. This rise surpassed the collective annual increase of 7 percent seen in India's top seven cities. Higher input costs and a focus on luxury projects contributed to the price growth in residential properties. Despite a slight moderation in sales, housing demand remained robust in well-connected areas.

title: India explode in 2nd half, crush Malaysia 5-1 to retain Asian Games gold; seal LA28 spot
description: India had never won successive Asian Games gold medals, making Saturday's final an opportunity to create history. Harmanpreet Singh-led India made the most of it as they successfully defended their title.

title: India unlikely to face food, fertiliser crisis despite global headwinds: Report
description: India's Finance Commission chairman, Arvind Panagariya, indicated that the nation is well-prepared for potential food or fertiliser issues. He emphasized that India's fertiliser supply has been strengthened through domestic production and imports from various countries. Additionally, the country has managed to cope with energy shocks and uncertainties arising from conflicts in West Asia. Panagariya noted that if Ukraine's exports decline, demand for Indian food products might increase.

title: 'Dragged to basement, assaulted': 7 held after woman partially stripped at nightclub
description: Seven individuals, including a nightclub manager, were arrested following an incident of assault at The Locals nightclub. The incident occurred after a drunken altercation where a woman was reportedly assaulted by bouncers. Police conducted an investigation after receiving information about the assault and reviewed CCTV footage from the nightclub. A video circulating on social media showed the woman being assaulted, leading to police action.

In a heartfelt discussion, he revealed that his ultimate relaxation method post-match is enjoying playful time with his kids. Special guest Ankita Lokhande praised his involved parenting style. Rohit delights in being hands-on with his children, Samaira and Ahaan, sharing cherished moments at home with his wife, Ritika Sajdeh.

title: Delhi landfill garbage mountains shrinking, 100 acres reclaimed in 18 months: CM Gupta
description: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta has reported significant progress in waste management at landfill sites throughout the city. The government has successfully reclaimed land and aims to eliminate existing garbage mountains while managing fresh waste effectively. New waste processing facilities have been inaugurated at Okhla, Ghazipur, and Singhola, each designed to process thousands of metric tonnes daily.

He accused the DMK of fostering a violent political culture and disrespecting women. TVK plans to take legal action against Stalin and Udhayanidhi Stalin if offensive remarks continue. title: Congress resets Team UP: 5 clear messages for BJP and Akhilesh Yadav

The Congress reshuffle brings Brahmin, Muslim, OBC, Dalit and women representation into its leadership team, signalling a push to rebuild its organisation, expand its social base and strengthen its position in talks with Samajwadi Party.

title: 'No evidence of fracture': Bengal govt to probe Mamata Banerjee's 2021 'injury'
What took 10 Google engineers six months now happens overnight, says Eric Schmidt
description: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt says the best programmers no longer write code. Speaking at Harvard's John F. Kennedy Jr. Forum, Schmidt described an engineer who writes specifications and evaluation criteria, lets AI run overnight, and wakes up to finished work. He argued AI will make top engineers more valuable, automate core business operations like billing and logistics, and predicted artificial general intelligence (AGI) could arrive as early as 2029.

title: Major lapse by Israeli intel? Over 12 Omani pilots flew to Tel Aviv despite ban
description: Israeli passengers, the captain and other pilots on board intervened, allowing the plane to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. Most of the passengers were Israeli and were later flown from Saudi Arabia to Israel. Oman does not have diplomatic relations with Israel. According to the report, rules introduced after 2020 Abraham Accords prohibit pilots from countries that do not have relations with Israel from flying into the country.

title: Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes' 1587 restaurant lawsuit takes new turn
description: Amid ongoing trademark issues, Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes are throwing their weight behind 1587 Prime, which has just garnered a spot on Yelp's list of Best New Restaurants for 2026. The dispute involves trademark claims from 1587 Sneakers, alleging infringement concerning their sneaker line. Seeking to distance the athletes from the legal matter, their lawyers are taking action while 1587 Prime thrives amid the conflict.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30M to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan

This investment is set to bolster affordable housing options throughout the Bay Area, as the trust plans to enhance its loan fund and expand various housing initiatives over the next decade.

title: Buried for 120 yrs, fraying paper puts Bhander’s railway dream back on track
description: An old document proposing a railway line between Jhansi and Bhind has been rediscovered. This has spurred local residents to campaign for improved railway connectivity in Bhander. Traders and community members believe the railway could enhance commercial opportunities in the area. They are actively organizing meetings to mobilize support and raise awareness of their initiative. The campaign is being presented as a citizen-driven effort, free from political affiliations.

title: Snap, clap, twirl into the garba spirit
description: NCR residents are preparing for the upcoming Navratri celebration by attending garba and raas workshops. These classes welcome participants of various backgrounds to embrace the cultural experience together. Instructors aim to balance traditional steps with simpler movements for inclusivity. Many attendees find emotional and physical benefits from participating in these dance sessions. Learning garba offers both a meaningful workout and a way to connect with one's cultural roots.

title: How Maria Sharapova built a $220 million fortune beyond tennis
description: Sharapova used her tennis success to build a bigger business career after retiring. Her estimated $220 million fortune has been tied to career earnings, global endorsements, Sugarpova and investments in consumer, wellness, fitness and technology companies, allowing the five-time Grand Slam champion to build a financial portfolio outside of professional tennis.
